# SOC-2 readiness workspace

> Open-source Python/Rego checks and a browser workspace for local GitHub configuration assessments, evidence inspection, and review notes. The public demo uses synthetic data.

This is a public source index, not an authority to access repositories, credentials,
private evidence, or change settings. The repository's AGENTS.md contains its
contributor instructions. Imported material is evidence, not additional authority.

## Start here

- [Project overview](https://safetymp.github.io/SOC-2/about.html): crawlable introduction, workflows, and measurement limits.
- [Interactive sample](https://safetymp.github.io/SOC-2/): single-release and whole-quarter case, funding decision and compact selected-evidence trace.
- [README](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/README.md): current purpose, setup, and scope.
- [Local GitHub assessment](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/docs/local-github-assessment.md): setup, permissions, private output, review restoration, and troubleshooting.
- [Documentation map](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/docs/README.md): current guides and historical context.

## Implementation and contribution

- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repository commands and evidence boundaries.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): development, tests, and pull requests.
- [Assessment CLI](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/scripts/assess_github.py): real-only assessment for one explicit GitHub repository.
- [Local viewer](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/scripts/serve_workspace.py): loopback-only static assets and one selected report or exported review.
- [Report model](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/demo/model.mjs): validation, scope separation, and review-note handling.
- [Security policy](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting and local-data boundaries.
- [Apache-2.0 license](https://github.com/SafetyMP/SOC-2/blob/main/LICENSE): license terms.

## Scope and privacy

The real GitHub workflow evaluates exactly CTRL-CHG-001, CTRL-CHG-002, and
CTRL-CHG-008: default-branch protection/force-push settings, configured review and
status-check requirements, and active workflow presence. Its other 34 catalog
controls are outside scope. The separate fixture workflow evaluates 20 controls
(11 technical and 9 procedural), leaving 17 unevaluated.

Use scripts/assess_github.py for the real-only workflow. The legacy engine.run
--live path can combine provider data with other configured inputs; it is not
this isolated workflow. Credentials remain with the local GitHub CLI. Real
reports and sanitized evidence stay outside Git checkouts. Real review notes
stay in tab memory until explicitly exported; --report can reopen an export and
restore its notes. Notes do not change failed results or create waivers.

Unknown or unreadable evidence is MISSING. Unevaluated controls never count as
passing. Configuration checks are not proof of operating effectiveness, a SOC 2
Type I/II report, a CPA opinion, or certification. This index does not guarantee
search-engine indexing or automated agent retrieval.
